packageRules.description: Labels the release-signing surface so ci.yml's auto-merge job skips a bump to it rather than arming auto-merge (ci.yml records the timing this relies on: the label must already be on the PR when its opened event fires). Every merge to the default branch already needs an approving review (the ruleset); on a PR with auto-merge armed that approval merges it on the spot, and without it a signing bump needs a separate, deliberate merge after approval. The label is what does the work: auto-merge is armed by that job, which never reads this file, and its condition excludes this label (enforced by verifyAutomergeLabelExclusion in mage dev:check). automerge:false is Renovate's own default and is recorded here as intent only. Renovate unions addLabels across a grouped branch, so a group with any of these packages in it carries the label too. This matters because no PR check runs cosign — signing happens in container-images.yml's merge job and in helm-chart.yml, which has no pull_request trigger — so a bump that changed signing behaviour would go green on a PR and first misbehave on a tag.
openvox-ca-integ is built locally by mage and not published to any registry
The root compose.yml is a deployment example; keep its image reference floating rather than digest-pinned
Don't pin CentOS Stream, old digests aren't retained after updates

The chart is validated against both Helm majors in ci.yml's chart matrix and packaged by one of them in helm-chart.yml; dev:check (verifyChartPins) refuses a packaging pin the matrix does not list, so the matrix leg and the packaging pin have to arrive together. Renovate's default branch topic already co-locates them (same depName, same newMajor); grouping per major states that requirement instead of inheriting it. The major must stay in the group name — a bare 'Helm' collapses both legs into one branch, which is the coupling ci.yml's fail-fast: false exists to avoid

Never offer to move a Helm pin across a major. Each matrix leg exists to cover the major it names, so a major update proposes deleting that coverage rather than refreshing it, and it would collide with the other leg's own patch update in the same group. Adding or retiring a major is a hand edit to the matrix
Allow Renovate to bump the 'go' directive in go.mod
The 'go' directive in go.mod and the golang builder image are the same toolchain; move them in one PR

bun's core module and its dialect and driver modules are one release: every submodule is tagged at the core's version, and each one that imports the core (all but driver/sqliteshim) requires exactly that version and replaces it with the in-tree copy (replace github.com/uptrace/bun => ../..), so it is only ever built against the core at the same commit. Taken one at a time they skew — bun v1.3.0 beside mysqldialect v1.2.18 fails every package that links the SQL backend, at init (#418–#423). config:best-practices does not group them: group:monorepos has no bun entry. The bare name is listed because the glob alone does not match the core module

etcd's api, client and server modules are one release: they share a version, and the client and server require their siblings at exactly that version and replace them with the in-tree copies. Split, the server PR drags the client along through MVS, which autocloses the client's own PR (#389, #152, #108), while the api moves in a separate merge (#388 before #390), so main briefly holds a mix the etcd project never tagged together. config:best-practices does not group them: group:monorepos has no etcd entry. go.etcd.io/raft and go.etcd.io/bbolt are separate repositories on their own version lines, so the match stops at go.etcd.io/etcd/
